title: Trump organization hosts ‘exclusive’ dinner to promote president’s meme coin | CNN Politics
text:
Source: CNN

President Donald Trump was the featured speaker at a private event on Sunday where the price of admission was a major stake in his meme coin.

The White House referred CNN’s questions about the event to the hosts. The companies behind the event — CIC Digital and Fight Fight Fight LLC — are affiliates of the Trump Organization. They did not respond to a request for comment. Trump’s official schedule on Sunday listed him going to the golf club, like many weekends, but did not specify that event.

Itwas advertisedas an “evening of legends,” featuring boxing legend Floyd Mayweather and former NBA player Tristan Thompson. Also in attendance was “Shark Tank” investor Kevin O’Leary.

The top 29 holders of the coin were promised a special VIP reception at the gala held at Trump’s National Golf Club in Sterling, Virginia, billed as a “once-in-a-lifetime experience.” The top four holders were promised a Trump 18-karat gold watch. The $TRUMP coin has about 224,000 holders, according toCoinMarketCap, which tracks live data for cryptocurrencies.

Asocial media postof the event shows the president fielding questions about Elon Musk and Chinese food, among other topics.

“I always say about Elon: He’s 80% percent super genius and 20% I refuse to say what that is,” the president said at the dinner after being asked by an attendee to respond to Musk’s recent comment that hedoesn’t identify with the MAGA movement.

The Trump family’srapidly expanding crypto empirehas been a subject of concern for Democrats, who have alleged that the president is using his office for financial gain. The president attended a similar gala last May, which his critics called a textbookpay-to-play venture.Duringan interviewon CBS’s “60 Minutes” earlier this month, Trump defended the fact his net worth has gone up by $3 billion since the start of his second term, largely due to cryptocurrency, comparing his earnings to those of previous presidents.

“Well, but they own something, whatever crypto was at the time,” the president said. “You know, there’s crypto and before that there was oil …”

The value of the $TRUMP meme coin has recently plummeted, trading at $0.89 onthe Kraken cryptocurrency exchangeSunday after reaching $1.73 just before Halloween.

The venture is nonetheless likely to be among a list of targets for investigation by Democrats when they gain control of Congress in January. Last month, several Democrats senta letter to the White Housepushing for more details on the first meme coin gala.

On Sunday, Sen. Richard Blumenthal, a ranking member of the Senate Judiciary Committee who last year sponsoreda resolution condemningthe meme coin venture, heaped fresh criticism on the operation.

“Trump is clearly more focused on profiting from his pump-and-dump meme coin operation than addressing Americans’ soaring cost of living crisis,” Blumenthal said in a statement. “He has put a ‘For Sale’ sign on the White House through the $TRUMP coin and other crypto dealings. Countless Americans have likely been deceived by an apparent pump-and-dump scheme that benefited a privileged set of insiders and cost ordinary investors billions of their hard-earned money.”

Donald Sherman, president of Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics in Washington, or CREW, a liberal-leaning watchdog group, said the sweeping Republican midterm losses should serve as “a clear mandate” to the president and Congress that corruption is a top concern.

“Donald Trump’s memecoin dinner is the clearest evidence that he cares more about lining his pockets and giving access to his personal investors than addressing the problems facing the American public,” Sherman told CNN. “Congress needs to ensure oversight of and accountability for the president.”

Speaking to attendees Sunday, Trump expressed support for proposed legislation around cryptocurrency, known as the CLARITY Act, and said he believes there will be bipartisan support for it.

“In fact, I think we’re going to have a lot of bipartisan support for everything because I’ll be the veto king of the world,” he added.

The website for holders of the president’s meme coin states that it is “not political and has nothing to do with any political campaign or any political office or governmental agency.”

This story has been updated with additional information.
